fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 has no composition or scaling lemma. Propagation to only m^delta bags cannot itself yield Omega(m^(1+delta)) squared excess with O(m) ordinary equal-energy anchors; the missing factor must come from an unavoidable weighted residual or growing coefficients, so any cheap zero-residual pseudodistribution kills it.

Proposal 1 is not yet fully specified: the expander family, hierarchy incidence, rational weights, delta, target, and acceptance thresholds are absent. Adaptive choices after seeing results would make its proposed experiment non-discriminating.

Proposal 2 merely restates the missing formula-uniform sparse Nullstellensatz theorem. Degree-2 through degree-6 tests cannot address classical proof-complexity degree/size obstructions, and no polynomial-size monomial-selection rule or CVP distance argument is supplied.

Proposal 3 supplies neither a concrete formula complex nor a specified product and target. Homological nontriviality or Hamming cosystole does not imply a lower bound on unrestricted integral Euclidean filling norm, while harmful selector cycles may be boundaries.

Proposals 4, 5, and 6 cannot obtain an unbounded local shell ratio. For any finite set of equal-radius legal lattice vectors, choose legal u,v with 2u-v outside that set; then 2u-v is a lattice vector and its distance from the target is at most 3r, so nonlinear carries, positive-definite forms, and tensoring cannot produce n^c separation.

Tensoring also leaves overlap composition and clause deletion unresolved; one tensor-square pass would not establish multiplicativity. No concrete base gadget is identified, so Proposal 6's experiment is not presently executable.
evidence: Generation 5 found norm-at-most-4 overlap kernel moves in every tested composed local-isolation system, directly requiring Proposal 1 to prove rather than assume global composition.

Generations 7 and 11 exhibit exact signed zero-residual attacks, including constant-cost seven-term parity. Generation 13 proves one such parity lies in the honest affine span and defeats every compatible raw linear syndrome.

Generation 12 shows that charging parity alone exposes clause deletion. Generation 14's complete pair bags passed only one finite shell, while their quadratic baseline and linear deletion attack force the asymptotic ratio toward one.

Proposal 1 is the sole candidate that structurally mutates the Generation-14 failure by using O(m) sparse bags, explicit deletion weights, and enlarged joint coordinates. This escapes the existing impossibility statements but supplies no soundness result yet.
No supplied verifier supports any asymptotic claim; all successful results are fixed-instance shell or affine-fiber facts.

Kill immediately for any external filter/free slack, any zero-residual harmful vector below threshold, any weighted drop below threshold, or failure of honest radius B(m)=O(m); a pass remains finite evidence only.
